locations.note: A curator's murder in the Louvre sets symbologist Robert Langdon on the Grail trail.
The curator Saunière is found dead in the Grand Gallery, and Langdon reads the clues he left among the paintings.
Langdon reaches the church after Silas has been there, and finds a nun who saw the monk search beneath the gnomon.
Langdon and Neveu take refuge with the Grail historian Sir Leigh Teabing at his château outside Paris.
Clues lead Langdon and Neveu to Temple Church and Westminster Abbey in London.
The Templar church is the next clue; in its courtyard Remy turns on Langdon and Neveu.
Teabing is held in the abbey, where the riddle of the knight a pope interred is solved.
Rosslyn Chapel near Edinburgh is the final stop in the hunt for the Grail.

routes.name: Langdon and Neveu
routes.note: From the murder in the Louvre to Temple Church and Westminster Abbey in London, then Rosslyn Chapel and back to Paris.
